source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of DNA replication (PDF 123).

blocks.text: DNA replication woh amal hai jis mein DNA molecule apni hu-ba-hu copy (replica) banata hai. DNA do strands ka double helix hai, is liye dono strands ki copy banti hai.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Chromatids ka DNA replicate hota hai taa ke chromatids dugne ho saken. Yeh cell ke taqseem hone se pehle, interphase ke S-phase mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Cell cycle ke kis marhale mein DNA replicate hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Interphase ke S-phase mein, cell taqseem se pehle.

items: Replication: DNA apne double helix ke dono strands copy karta, S-phase mein.
